scope: Zurich real + downloaded PolyGNN mini; all qualifying pairs, source strata separate

selection.strict_topology: watertight, consistent winding, triangle area > 1e-12 in author coordinates; no mesh repair
selection.independent_check: Blender boundary/nonmanifold/winding/degenerate counts zero, signed volume positive, no nonadjacent BVH overlap candidate; not a full intersection proof

preprocessing.input: finite float64 Nx3 XYZ; preserve all points and order
preprocessing.origin: midpoint of input point bounding box, never derived from GT
preprocessing.ground_truth: apply exactly the input-derived transform to all GT vertices and wireframe vertices
preprocessing.filtering: no denoising, point removal, augmentation, downsampling, inferred ground points or GT repair
preprocessing.units: canonical analysis units, not metres; original source units retained in provenance

usage.metrics: report real/simulated separately, fixed local evaluator; not official challenge metrics
usage.reference_bias: GT-informed quality curation, single-city real data and mini synthetic selection restrict generalization
